text_block_list.text: A few hours earlier...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, let us commence our
strategy meeting for the second Spring
Choice Chocolatier Contest. I, Mihono
Bourbon, will
lead.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, are those the uniforms?! The
quality is crazy good!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is. Even I'm surprised by how well-made
and beautiful they look. We decided to
wear them so that we could get used to
working in
them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I knew that design would fit you
perfectly!
You look great, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I am grateful for your insight
during the selection process.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, our introduction has overrun by one
minute. Shall we get started,
then?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The brief for this year's contest is to
create
a dessert based on the
school.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So based on Tracen?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I conducted a survey of all the academy's
students and inquired what
images of
Tracen come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
From that, I took the most popular
answer—the training grounds—and
made a
design based on that motif.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We're aiming to have the recipe finalized
at least five days before the contest,
allowing room for trial and error along
the
way.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So we'd like to see what things you all
would want to add. Your
suggestions
could be of great assistance to us.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Th-then can I give it a try too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Let's split into two teams.
I'll go
with Bourbon and
Bakushin O, and you'll
be with Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! So you would have me as
captain of whipped cream? Leave it in my
capable hands! I'll have it whipped up
before you know
it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O, there's a whisk cooling in the
fridge, so please use that
one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
It's freezing!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Heh, apologies. Using a warm whisk would
weaken the structure of
the fats in the
cream, making it harder to contain air.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Recorded to memory logs. I've learned
something new today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (W-wow... Amazing. She's got the knowledge and the techniques of a pro!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Wait! This is no time to be standing
around gawking! I was lucky
enough to be
invited,
so I'd better make myself useful!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is now time to present the completed
trial cakes. Each cake will
receive
feedback. Please begin with ours, Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This is a trifle themed on the
training
grounds. We've replicated
the appearance
of the real grounds on a miniature scale.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Next, Flower and Jordan. Please present
your cake for evaluation.
...Um, where is
your cake?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... You see...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(The idea is to make something that will
be useful for Flash... Which
means it's got
to be high-level...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's try making an opera cake! I think
having a top layer of glossy chocolate
would be a good way to represent the
prestige of Tracen
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aight... Wait, hold up. Is this recipe for
real?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Buttercream, ganache, coffee syrup,
glazing—all ready. The cake
batter is nice
and cool now too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I am shook! You pretty much did everything on your own! What's left? To put it all together?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yep! I'll go ahead and do it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Gently... Gently... Phew,
that's the coffee
syrup on. Now for... the
buttercream...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (What?! It solidified!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Oh, I must've been too slow. Oh no!
Okay, I've just got to melt it in a

bain-marie...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Aah!
Crash!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And in my panic, I dropped the cake
batter... So we couldn't finish
the cake in
time. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see... I'm sorry I didn't notice the
difficulties you were having.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But failure is all a part of the baking
process. Please don't let it
dampen your
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: O-okay! I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but don't let me disrupt you any
further! Please continue with your

evaluation!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well, about that...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've made this trial cake, I've
realized... I'm not sure if it's
enough to
really represent Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The grounds have an impressive variety of
courses—that much is true.
But perhaps
this is too literal...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please let me hear your opinions. When
you look at this trifle, do you
feel like it
represents Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. That settles it. This won't be
enough to win first prize.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I believe...
we'll have to go a step further
with the concept. First, let's
think of ways
to expand on—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, we only have thirty minutes and
twenty seconds left of our
session. Let's
move on to cleaning up and continue next
time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...
Whew... Okay.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! You lookin' kinda sad, bestie. You
okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Jordan! Well, um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking...
I wish I was a bit more
reliable, you know? That's
all it is.
N-nothing to worry about, so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh... Sigh... Great, now she's apologizing to me too...

text_block_list.name: Quiet Classmate
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Listen,
bestie! Let's just have some fun and
eat something good.
Things are gonna be
lit!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I wanna hear all the tea about your trainer! Let's go grab a burger!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Sorry.
I'm not feeling up for fun right now,
so... maybe next time.
Thanks though.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh, ah—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...
I haven't changed at all! Agh, I suck at
this!
